# Basketball GM Independent Player Profiles — Complete AI-Readable Export

## Fidelity statement

This file is a complete logical export of the workbook for AI ingestion. It includes every worksheet in tab order, every cell in each worksheet used range, blank structural cells inside those ranges, formulas and cached values where present, hidden-sheet state, merged ranges, freeze panes, table definitions, hyperlinks, conditional-formatting rules, data-validation rules, defined names, chart titles and source references, and the XLSX package inventory.

Nothing was summarized out of the worksheet data. Excel-only visual presentation such as exact font rendering, pixel dimensions, theme colors, and border drawing cannot be reproduced as a Markdown interface; related structural and rule metadata is retained where it affects meaning.

## AI reading instructions

1. Treat **Production Profiles**, **By Position**, **Profile Thresholds**, **Morph Neighbors**, **Attribute Framework**, and **Design Method** as the production design system.
2. Treat **Research Crosswalk** as internal reference only. Do not copy or ship the research labels.
3. In sheet tables, the first column labeled **Excel Row** is the original worksheet row number.
4. Empty Markdown cells represent empty Excel cells preserved inside the worksheet used range.
5. Any cell containing `FORMULA:` preserves the original formula and cached result.

Keep the Research Crosswalk internal. Do not ship NBA 2K labels, badges, exact ratings/data, logos, interface elements, or an exact source selection/arrangement. This is a risk-reduction design method, not a guarantee of legal compliance or legal advice. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| 8 | Design Rule | Meaning |  | Placeholder Match Logic |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| 9 | Core principle | Players are never assigned an irreversible class. Ratings change, every eligible profile score recalculates, and the displayed label may change. |  | Per-attribute progress | Progressᵢ = clamp((Ratingᵢ − RookieLowᵢ) ÷ (PrimeTargetᵢ − RookieLowᵢ), 0, 1) | Scores growth from raw signal to polished target. |  |  |  |  |
| 10 | Profile unit | Use Profile ID + Applied Position. The same profile may require different attributes at PG, PF, or C. |  | Profile match score | MatchScore = 100 × Σ(Progressᵢ × Weightᵢ) ÷ Σ(Weightᵢ) | Compares the player to every profile without class locks. |  |  |  |  |
| 11 | Rookie meaning | Rookie Signal Low/High describes early evidence only. A prospect does not need to begin inside one profile’s ranges. |  | Rookie signal count | Count Core attributes where Rating ≥ Rookie Signal High | Prevents one isolated skill from naming a prospect too early. |  |  |  |  |
| 12 | Threshold meaning | Mature Minimum marks an established version of the role. Prime Target represents a polished end-state, not a mandatory cap. |  | Core target count | Count Core attributes where Rating ≥ Mature Minimum | Measures how much of the mature role is actually present. |  |  |  |  |
| 13 | Hard gates | None. Every requirement row is marked No. Count rules and match-score bands are soft display rules. |  | Top-profile rule | Store the three highest scores after each development update | Keeps multiple paths alive and makes morphing visible. |  |  |  |  |
| 14 | Hidden development | Work Ethic, Coachability, Adaptability, Learning Capacity, and Professionalism modify development probability/rate, not normal role identity. |  | Hybrid rule | If the top two scores are within 5 points, display Transitional: A / B | Avoids false precision when the player sits between roles. |  |  |  |  |
| 15 | Measurements | Height, weight, wingspan, standing reach, and hand size are soft fit modifiers. They should not permanently block a role. |  | Display rule | Do not display a permanent end-state profile below a 65 match score | Lets newbies remain raw or developing instead of being forced into a class. |  |  |  |  |
| 16 | Hidden health | Health and injury-risk ratings affect availability and decline, not the profile match score. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| 17 | Age / usage separation | A veteran may retain the same skill profile while athletic activation, role usage, and production decline. That separate math is intentionally not implemented here. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
